text:
liang: Heads-up — bringing up maru-v0 on int8 yesterday; initial perf looks good but we see detok issues for mixed CJK + RTL contexts in our smoke evals. Repro attached.
emma_ml: can you paste the failing examples?
liang: Sure — from smoke-run (sha: 7a1f2c). Input: "（示例）שלום 世界" => model output tokens: "（示例)שָׁלוֹם  世界" — notice missing ideographic space and Hebrew bracket mirroring weirdness.
sasha: hmm bracket mirroring usually comes from the bidi pass during detok. Which tokenizer and detok code path? byte-level? spm?
liang: using sentencepiece-based tokenizer (maru-v0.spm), detokenizer = our detok v2 that merges ZWJ/ZWSP. Quantized kernel path uses kvcache layout x2.
kevin_research: also seeing embedding drift for zh/ja examples vs float32 baseline. Cosine sims (sample): float32->float32 avg 0.982, int8->float32 avg 0.915 across 500 samples.
maya_ops: perf numbers? latency/regression?
liang: int8 p50 tokens/s ~ 1.9x faster on A100 than fp16, but BLEU on mc-20 dev dropped 2.6 points for zh->en.
emma_ml: can you dump tokenization boundary cases? maybe sentencepiece we trained dropped some mixed-script merges.
liang: attached snippet: ```python
# quick repro
from maru_tokenizer import MaruTokenizer
t = MaruTokenizer('maru-v0.spm')
print(t.encode('（示例）שלום 世界'))
``` outputs array with separate fullwidth paren tokens and Hebrew letters glued to prior token.
sasha: Suggestion: run detok with bidi-aware normalization off to see if behavior changes. Also check kernel's bytepair merging order — quant path sometimes uses fallback tokenizer that strips U+200B.
kevin_research: I bisected weights — mismatch appears after kernel selection change in runtime that adjusted chunk size for KV caching (PR#4321). Rolling back that patch on a small canary removed the detok mismatch.
liang: ok good find. Can someone run a canary with PR#4321 reverted and run the int8-onboard smoke suite (eng-ml/smoke-multilang) across 2k samples? logs in /tmp/maru-int8-canary.log
sasha: I'll run it. ETA ~45m. I'll also run a quick embedding similarity pass and output failed examples to the thread.
devbot: Deploy started for canary maru-v0-int8-revert-4321 on gpu-pool-canary at 5109876780.
sasha: first pass: detok mismatches dropped from 24 -> 3 in 2k samples. embedding mean cosine rose to 0.957. attaching top 5 failing inputs.
liang: great. action items: (1) sasha to create a regression test for mixed CJK+RTL pairs (2) kevin to link the kernel change + benchmark PR and possible alternate chunking strategy (3) emma to rerun tokenizer retrain candidates for mixed-script merge rules.
emma_ml: noted, will run tokenizer retrain with added mixed-script merges and report.
sasha: opening the test ticket now: ENGML-1284, adding smoke assets and expected detok outputs. assigning to @sasha and @kevin_research.
liang: thanks all :thumbsup:
